overview: Set in the Arizona Territory in 1882, Ringo’s Tally follows infamous outlaw Johnny Ringo as he rides alone through the desert, hunted by the law, haunted by his enemies, and slowly losing control of himself. Drunk, exhausted and stranded after losing his horse, Ringo follows a distant firelight to a lonely campsite, where he meets a mysterious stranger carrying a dime novel written about his life.

title: Mike
overview: A young man spirals through buried trauma and impulsive choices, igniting a thrilling descent into loss, desperation, and survival.

title: Fresh Meat Anthology: Volume One
overview: Fresh Meat is a new annual horror shorts contest presented by Dead Meat and Hades Films. Approximately ten films will be chosen for the Fresh Meat Volume 1 anthology. The anthology premieres in theaters on or about October 12, 2026, followed by a digital release.

title: Dolioo
overview: Sarah Jamson, daughter of Hudson’s murdered ally, wages a one-woman war against Hudson, using stealth, strategy, and vengeance-marked corpses to haunt him psychologically. Chloe Varenne, a symbol of lost love and innocence, becomes the spark that pushes KAEL toward rebellion.

title: Eva
overview: On a romantic journey through isolated landscapes, a couple discovers that the most unsettling danger may arise from what they choose to hide or reveal.

title: NieR:Orchestra Concert 12026 [YoRHa]
overview: A new multimedia NieR orchestral production featuring full orchestra, chorus, vocalists Emi Evans and J’Nique Nicole, giant-screen visuals and a narrated story connected to the Pearl Harbor Descent Operation.

title: Arachnado 2: Flaming Spiders
overview: Just when you thought it couldn't get any worse, the Arachnado has returned, this time as a "Firenado" with Flaming Spiders. It's up to a renegade Sergeant Preston and the Janitor from the original film to overthrow the corrupt Lieutenant Gallagher and put the fire out.

title: Bunker Heights
overview: Citizens of a troubled city must navigate through an unforeseen crisis that threatens every walk of life.

title: Friday's Chylde 3D
overview: Friday's Chylde 3D

title: When the World Stood Still...
overview: During the COVID-19 pandemic, while the world came to a standstill, a group of teenagers began building a Minecraft server. What started as a simple world to play in slowly grew into a universe of kingdoms, characters, timelines and stories.  Years later, the people behind Elementia look back on the world they created, the memories they made, and the unexpected ways a generation found connection and creativity during a time of isolation.

title: Iron Boy
overview: In rural France, Christophe (10) tries to live up to his rigid and distant father on the family farm. But the young boy starts to lean over and collapse without warning — on the tractor, at school, at dinner... A doctor finds the solution: Christophe must wear an iron corset to keep himself upright. Forced to reinvent his life away from the farm, Christophe discovers a new passion for music, meets a new friend, and follows her into his first mischief. But will any of this really fix what is out of balance?

title: Street Fighter
overview: In 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu and Ken Masters are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don't, it's GAME OVER!

title: Minotaur
overview: When Gleb, a successful company director, finds himself under siege from mounting corporate pressures, an increasingly unstable world, and the discovery of his wife's affair, the collapse of his carefully ordered life accelerates toward violence.

title: Whalefall
overview: Following the death of his father, Jay Gardiner goes diving off the central Coast of California in search of his remains, but is swallowed by a massive sperm whale. While trapped inside its belly with only one hour of oxygen left, Jay comes to realize that the hard-earned lessons his father imparted may be the key to his escape.

title: Il était une fois le printemps
Love of Your Life
overview: A young woman loses her husband and goes on a journey to find a way forward in her life.

title: Les Misérables
overview: After enduring 19 years in prison for stealing a loaf of bread, Jean Valjean emerges a hardened man. He seeks redemption by reinventing himself as a respected dignitary under a new identity. He promises Fantine, a dying factory worker, to rescue and protect her daughter Cosette, who is being exploited and mistreated by the deceitful Thénardier family. As Valjean raises Cosette as his own, he is relentlessly pursued by Inspector Javert. Admist the social unrest shaking France, the fates of Valjean, Cosette, her lover Marius, and Javert become intertwined in a turbulent, revolutionary Paris. Through struggles, sacrifices, and a deep yearning for justice, Valjean strives to complete his journey of redemption and offer Cosette a future of love and freedom.

title: New Beginnings
overview: Al Moon lives a solitary life on the territory of the Yurok nation in California. Surrounded by violence and ecological threats affecting his people, buried anxieties from his time in Vietnam now begin to resurface. Driven by an urge to confront his past, Al Moon embarks on a cross-country journey, moving closer to uncovering a truth that has haunted him for decades.

title: Maleepnedos
overview: An epic journey of uncanny proportion in which two friends must adapt and survive the peculiarities of this strange new world.

title: Afreet - A Never Ending Night
overview: Three friends gather for what should have been an ordinary evening, but a seemingly harmless challenge unleashes something far older and more dangerous than they could have imagined. As strange events begin to blur the line between reality and the unknown, they find themselves trapped in a night where every choice carries a consequence.  Afreet is a supernatural horror film that explores friendship, fear, and the hidden forces that emerge when curiosity goes too far.

title: Jailer 2
overview: Following the events of "Jailer",  former ruthless police officer Muthuvel Pandian must come face-to-face with an even larger threat.

title: Dirty Angel
overview: A young woman gets involved in a typhoon of temptation, pressure, buried secrets and dangerous individuals that prowl the nocturnal streets and has to use her internal strength to create a new balance in her shattered life and start living to the fullest once again.

title: London
overview: Bobby drives back and forth between Vienna and Salzburg, giving lifts to strangers on the way, sharing conversations that drift from the mundane to the deeply personal. In this tender portrait of today’s Europe, anonymity and warmth still go hand in hand.

title: The Book of Dreams
overview: After his wife’s death, Bolot raises his daughter Kyial, who once defeated cancer. But the illness returns, and there is almost no time left. When he learns about her secret diary of wishes, Bolot decides to take Kyial out of the hospital and fulfill every one of her dreams. Joining them on this journey is Kyial’s best friend, Joki — a grown man on the autism spectrum, who in his own way helps them endure the pain and rediscover the value of every single day.

title: November 1963
overview: Unfolds within the intense 48-hour period surrounding the assassination of President John F. Kennedy. The film sheds light on crime group the Chicago Outfit’s alleged involvement in the assassination and draws directly from first-hand accounts, including insights from the family of crime boss Sam Giancana.

title: Дьол сэттэ күнэ
overview: Prokopiy, a 27-year-old boy with developmental disabilities, lives with his strict mother, Maria, who keeps him locked away for his own "safety." Life goes on as usual in a remote Yakut village until Prokopiy's cheerful sister, Aiyyna, arrives next door. She gives him warmth, attention, and a sense of "normality," and a simple, pure friendship blossoms between them, which becomes a revelation for the boy. Aiyyna leads him out of his locked room, takes him on a sleigh ride to a party, and for the first time makes him feel part of the outside world. But the closer Prokopiy gets to freedom, the more conflicts he has with his mother, who fears losing control and may not be able to protect her son from the pain society can inflict on him. A touching, harsh, and poetic coming-of-age story about a man who emerges from the safety of a locked world to an ambiguous freedom.

title: Seporsi Mie Ayam Sebelum Mati
overview: Plot under wraps.

title: Visitation
overview: A plot of land, a house by the lake, its changing inhabitants. This one plot of land reflects 70 years of German history from Weimar, the Nazis, the war, the Soviet occupation and reconstruction to the fall of the GDR.

title: Youri
overview: A chronicle of the unexpected but close friendship between introverted Dutch journalist Jan Brokken and extravagant Russian concert pianist Youri Egorov.

title: Televil
overview: Glah discovers an old TV in the storage room of his house. On the screen, 90s TV shows are being broadcast featuring four teens who went missing 35 years ago, crying out for help.

title: Dewi Siluman Ular
overview: Based on the podcast Prasodjo Muhammad “Nikah Sama Jin” with Sherly Indria (4.8M++ views on Youtube).

title: Руки вверх! 2
overview: Thirty years after the story of the band Ruki Vverkh! began, Sergey Zhukov together with his children revisits memories of his youth: his first love, his first big dreams, friendship, family, and the journey to the stage.

title: Filosofi Teras
overview: Since her father passed away, Nea has become the backbone of the family. She has to cover the household expenses, her mother Ratih’s needs, as well as her younger sister Runi’s college tuition and allowance. Meanwhile, her older brother Abi is still living with and depending on his wife, Ayu.  As Nea prepares to move forward with her boyfriend, Dio, and take their relationship to the next level, a painful truth is revealed. Their house had been pawned by their late father to pay for Abi and Ayu’s wedding. Nea is forced to bury her dreams and choose to endure everything for the sake of her family. In the midst of her distress, more and more problems arise, putting her through the hardest trials of her life.

title: Bohurupi: The Golden Daku
overview: Bohurupi: The Golden Daku is the much-awaited sequel to the 2024 all-time blockbuster Bohurupi, where Bikram and Jhimli return, stepping into a thrilling new chapter of adventure and high-stakes drama.

title: Divočina
overview: A story about family ghosts, wild pigs and the end of the world, which we all imagine differently. The drama Wilderness is an existential grotesque about building and breaking down family myths, love, memory and impermanence.

title: Приключения пингвиненка
overview: The penguin Kwi is transferred from the Moscow Zoo to another city. However, during the transportation, an accident occurs, and the baby ends up alone in a big city. Thus begins his incredible journey home.

title: Call Me Queen
overview: The film depicts a friendship between an Irish journalist in Kenya and a Rwandan woman, who pair up to combat the AIDS crisis in the 1990s.

title: Junkies of Dreaming
overview: Orchestra rehearsals with Teodor Currentzis. The House of the Radio of the GDR in Berlin. A young couple in love. The artistic process viewed from the outside – and from the inside. Mahler’s boundary-breaking Third Symphony. What triggered the composition 130 years ago, and what does it trigger in us today?

title: The Doll Ghawiah
overview: Plot under wraps, Spin-off of The Doll (2016).

title: Parallel Consequences
overview: Max and his friends, Pedro and Bruna, discover a time machine and decide to test it. What begins as an adventure quickly turns into a nightmare when Pedro inexplicably tries to kill Max, who must repeatedly travel back a few seconds in time to survive and uncover the truth. Caught in an unstable timeline, the three friends confront dark truths about themselves, the weight of their choices, and the unpredictable consequences of trying to rewrite destiny.

title: The Last Goodbye: Not Just Yet
overview: Based off the Wattpad Series by PRNCSPLM the third book in the series following The Both Sides Of Me. The last and final year of Junior High in 10 Sapphire everything changes when Chase's Ex Mackzyn transfers in his school and his section.

title: The Rites Of The Demons Of Westport
overview: The Rites Of The Demons Of Westport is a Thriller/Horror story based off the Wattpad Webstory by PRNCSPLM also known as Chase Pulumbarit, adapted by Aliah Dela Cruz.

title: Masterplan
overview: A legendary thief sets his sights on the Mona Lisa, da Vinci’s iconic painting residing at Le Louvre museum in Paris. He recruits two young strangers to help him — a sharp Italian cybercrime expert and a swaggering French explosives specialist — before revealing they are long-lost siblings and that he is their father. Thrown into a chaotic reunion they never asked for, this new family must learn to work together — and try not to kill each other — if they want any chance at pulling off the heist of the century.

title: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend
overview: Faced with the truth about Miori and Touko Kirishima, Sakuta must make a choice. This will be his final case of Adolescence Syndrome!

title: Tenzing
overview: A determined man embarks on a high-stakes quest—and defies seemingly impossible odds—to fulfill his dream of being the first to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

title: Flywheel: Ignition of the Soul
overview: In Rio de Janeiro, Noah Silva is a smooth-talking, used-car salesman whose 'do whatever it takes' approach to business and life begins to unravel at home and at work. After a series of wake-up calls, Noah is forced to confront the cost of his choices. He begins a difficult and deeply personal journey to restore his integrity while trying to win back the hearts of his wife and son.

title: Once Upon a Time in Harlem
overview: A decade after his death, genre-defying filmmaker William Greaves has one last trick up his sleeve with what he considered the most important event he captured on film: a 1972 party he engineered with the living luminaries of the Harlem Renaissance.

title: B-Town
overview: Based on a true story, B-Town is a tale of emotions, aspirations, and the harsh realities of Punjabi student life in Brampton, Ontario.

title: Aa Bata Aama 2
overview: Plot to be announced.

title: The Only Living Pickpocket in New York
overview: Harry Lehman is an aging pickpocket who plies his trade with ever-diminishing returns in a drastically changed New York. Wallets stuffed with cash have been replaced by easily cancelled credit cards, and Harry struggles to make ends meet as he cares for his disabled wife, Rosie. When he unwittingly purloins and fences a valuable USB stick, Harry finds himself in a race against time to return the loot or face the rage of a vengeful crime family.

title: Batulo Jun
overview: Plot to be announced.

title: mentor
overview: Fifteen years ago, an innocent fireworks accident caused by two boys, Ryunosuke and Takumi, destroyed an apartment building. One resident, Nomoto, lost his wife and child in the fire and suffered severe burns across his body. Fifteen years later, Ryunosuke tries to live a "normal" life while suppressing his guilt, whereas Takumi remains emotionally trapped in the past. When Nomoto suddenly reappears before them, the expected confrontation never comes. Instead, he shows an unsettling kindness—one that deeply disturbs Ryunosuke, yet offers a fragile sense of salvation to Takumi. As their paths cross once again in a reunion that should never have happened, the lives of these three individuals begin to shift in ways that will irrevocably alter their futures.

title: The Eken: Kerala-e Kurukshetra
overview: Eken Babu’s next adventure, releasing on 16 October 2026.

title: Trust Me, I'm a Doctor
overview: The life of Dr. Sandeep Kapoor was turned upside down when he's implicated in the wrongful death trial of one-time Playboy centerfold Anna Nicole Smith.

title: Arne Goes to Space
overview: Two small-town brothers are visited by an alien. Having crash-landed in the forests of Norrbotten, the visitor is named Roland. The brothers, Arne and Stefan, teach him everything important about life on Earth, including moonshine, hunting, and the mystery of love.

title: La maleta
overview: Laura and Nacho meet on a flight, but their brief encounter ends when they pick up their bags. Laura proposes a game, revealing the suitcase belongs to terrorists.

title: Musk
overview: A definitive and unvarnished examination of multi-billionaire tech entrepreneur Elon Musk.

title: Your Silent Face
overview: A man in a seemingly stable relationship hides a private world of fantasy that slowly takes over his life. When a third presence appears, he is forced to confront what his addiction has done to intimacy, love and his own sense of self.

title: Red Dirt
overview: When Emma Bennett, a teen girl living in the South, finds out life changing news, she has to find a way to navigate it with the help of her best friend Oliver, all while keeping it a secret from her step brother, Jake.

title: #Untitled Sangeeth Shobhan - Palnati Surya Pratap Project
The Pension Heist
overview: The film PENSJONSKUPPET (The Pension Heist) tells the story of three women in their prime who are written off as "too old" by their employers, their spouses, and even the healthcare system. But this feisty trio refuses to take it lying down. Together, they hatch a cunning plan to pull off the ultimate score… robbing Norway’s very own Sovereign Wealth Fund – the famous Oil Fund.

title: The Time That Never Came
overview: In a world obsessed with youth, Sara chose to age naturally while Oskar, her partner, took an anti-aging treatment. Years later, when they reunite — divided by time but bound by the past — Sara begins a journey to reclaim lost love, confront buried emotions and find freedom.

title: Carlo Acutis: The Millennial Saint
overview: A high-profile documentary about 15-year-old Carlo Acutis, who, in 2025, become the Roman Catholic Church’s first millennial saint.

title: Yalla Parkour
overview: In her relentless pursuit of a memory that reinforces her sense of belonging, Areeb crosses paths with Ahmed, a parkour athlete in Gaza, sparking a journey where conflicting aspirations intersect. Nostalgia meets with ambition, and the weight of a confined past meets with an unpredictable future.

title: Mellan Himmel och Körtburkar
overview: A feature film by the comedy group Småstadsliv, featuring recurring personalities from their universe. The plot revolves around hilarious and zany events—imbued with true small-town spirit and featuring colorful characters—including the debut of the character Sari as a psychopath.

title: The Observer
overview: A UFO mystery/thriller inspired by The Twilight Zone. Plot TBA.

title: Dirt in Your Face
overview: In the summer of 1987, Estonia languishes under Soviet rule, stifling free expression. 17-year-old Mihkel, a rebellious musician, and his rival Hendrik learn of a Finnish talent scout visiting Estonia. To impress him, they must journey to a distant rock festival on the other side of the country. They assemble a group, including Mihkel's secret love Liisa. Amid rivalry and chaos, they navigate challenges, discovering their true selves along the way.

title: Vape Glow
overview: Told entirely from the perspective of a recalled vape pen, Mike puffs around a dark vacation rental, illuminating it during an unusual blackout.

title: Raah Tere Ne
overview: Burma, 1944. After abandoning his post in the British Indian Army and stealing a fortune in hidden gold, a Sikh soldier journeys toward Punjab alongside an Anglo-Burmese woman chasing a homeland she has never seen. As greed, war, betrayal, and grief leave a trail of broken lives behind them, he must decide whether the road ahead leads to vengeance, redemption, or a deeper understanding of the divine path that has been guiding him all along.

title: The Myth of Sisyphus
overview: As the world is ending and people across Los Angeles quietly vanish into blinding light, two teenagers journey to a radio tower to send a final broadcast, while a young man and his grandmother confront what it means to be the last ones left.

title: flow
overview: A young person records a quiet walk through the woods. What begins as a casual video slowly reveals something harder to say.

title: Where Time Lingers
overview: A woman's daily routine is upended when she finds a reminder of times she'd repressed.

title: Georgia
overview: Famous Vegas director Steven Leroy receives a video link of the Kartvelian sword fighting dance from his daughter Mirrey. It impresses him so much that decides to travel to Sakartvelo in order to create an unforgettable show.

title: Clayface
overview: Follow the terrifying descent into hell of a promising Hollywood actor who has become a monster driven by revenge, exploring the loss of identity and humanity, the ravages of toxic love and the dark side of scientific ambition.

title: Klara and the Sun
overview: When Klara, an Artificial Friend who wants nothing more than to find the perfect home, meets Josie, each immediately senses a kindred spirit in the other. Josie has a fraught relationship with her mother and they've suffered great loss, but Klara's innocent wonder and unwavering loyalty begin to heal the family and bring light to Josie's complicated world.

title: Coward
overview: Pierre, a young Belgian soldier, wants to prove himself on the battlefield during the First World War. Behind the frontlines, he meets Francis, who is asked to find a way to boost morale.

title: Wicker
overview: On the outskirts of a village by the sea, lives a Fisherwoman; smelly, single and perpetually ridiculed. One day, fed up with her stuffy, small-minded neighbours, she commissions herself a husband to be made from wicker. In an otherwise conservative town, this unconventional romance sparks outrage, jealousy and chaos.

title: Marie Madeleine
overview: In Jacmel, Haiti, the sea, the churches, and the spirits shape daily life. Marie Madeleine is a free woman. She makes a living as a prostitute and navigates the nights without submitting to the rules of those who save souls. Her path crosses Joseph's, a young evangelist. A relationship blossoms between these two opposite beings. As Joseph’s faith wavers, Marie Madeleine draws him into a world where desire and the quest for freedom open up a space where everything can be reinvented.

title: Karma
overview: In a village in northern Spain, Jeanne tries to rebuild her life with Daniel, who knows nothing about her troubled past. One day, Jeanne's six-year-old godson mysteriously disappears and Jeanne becomes the main suspect.

title: These Violent Delights
overview: Juliet awakens from a fever dream. How did we get here? The lines between hallucination and memory blur as cinema and dance collide in a kaleidoscopic journey of queer belonging, defiance, and self-discovery. A vivid retelling of Shakespeare’s Romeo and Juliet brought to life by Scottish Ballet.

title: Let Love In
overview: After an affair comes to light, a couple's world unravels. Through confronting painful truths, they discover their crisis becomes a path to deeper connection and a new understanding of love.

title: Le Roi du Game
overview: In conflict with his daughter Isaure, Alexandre discovers that she has been selected for the oral exam of a prestigious business school—her greatest dream. However, Isaure is nowhere to be found, lost in a weekend of medieval fantasy role-playing. To find her, Alexandre enters the game, taking on the role of a devious Game Master. But as the adventure unfolds, he realizes that he himself has been lost for years. Under the guise of "Renard Chafouin," he gets a chance to reconnect with his values—and to avoid losing his daughter forever.

title: Une femme aujourd’hui
overview: The life of a young woman is turned upside down after a violent assault, making her realize the fragility of her freedom.

title: Wildwood
overview: Prue and her classmate Curtis are drawn into a forbidden magical forest filled with enchanted creatures, loyal allies, and formidable adversaries as they embark on a desperate quest to save Prue’s kidnapped baby brother, Mac, from the crows led by a mysterious woman named Alexandra.

title: The Sea Speaks His Name
overview: In the turbulent final years of Indonesia's New Order, 1998, a generation of young idealists risked everything for the dream of freedom. Among them is Biru Laut, a university student whose passion for justice and belief in democracy draws him into a secret circle of activists known as the Winatra group. The story follows the disappearance of Biru Laut and the subsequent search for him and other student activists by his family, particularly his younger sister Asmara Jati, revealing a dark period of Indonesian history marked by violence and the struggle for democracy.

title: The Perfect Holiday
overview: The group of friends from “Das perfekte Geheimnis” have to ask themselves the question on a chaotic short trip to the south: Is there life after the truth or is their friendship over?

title: The Lord of Cold
overview: Sisters Maria and Anastasia are best friends, and they cope not only with a grumpy mother, but also with ancient magic, because of which winter has not come in their village for many decades. The girls manage to overcome all obstacles, drive away the evil witch, melt the heart of the Lord of Cold, and also find love.

title: Сказка о потерянном времени
overview: An ordinary school day turns into a fantastic adventure for Petya, Marusya, and Vasya when their idle time becomes the source of power for three old wizards. In pursuit of youth, the villains steal the students' time with a magical gadget, but in their haste, they themselves turn into children, and the children into helpless old men. To set things right, they must not only win the magical battle but also lift the spell before sunset, and most importantly, understand the value of every wasted minute.

title: Dances with Weights
overview: After a misunderstanding, a famous strength athletics trainer accidentally finds himself at the position of training an elite dance squad, creating a conflict of interests which only increases after his protege Sashko falls in love with Milana, one of the the dance squad's most talented members. Will the two sides use their strengths to work together or will this match made in Hell crash and burn?

title: The Shepherd
overview: Set in the desolate Nevada night, a young woman in labor flees an abusive past who has her escape hijacked by a mysterious stranger hiding an ominous threat in the back of her car.

title: Josephine
overview: After eight-year-old Josephine accidentally witnesses a brutal assault in Golden Gate Park, she begins acting out violently to protect herself. This emotional trauma leads to conflicts between her parents as they search for justice, and a way to feel safe again.

title: Nakee 3: The Cursed War
overview: As destiny turns lovers into enemies, duty tears them apart, but love remembers what kingdoms forget, the love can end even the oldest war.

title: Women as Lovers
overview: Although hostess Brigitte and life-loving schoolgirl Paula only meet in person once, their fates and lives are closely intertwined.

title: Fallen Angels
overview: Two upper-class wives, their husbands away for the day, share a few toasts to their pre-marital dalliances—with the same man, who just may be en route from France to visit. Old rivalries and past scandals bubble to the surface in this intoxicating romp from one of theatre’s comedy masters.

title: Yellow Cake
overview: When radical science backfires, miners and researchers confront apocalypse in Tiago Melo’s pulpy, politically charged sci-fi fusing local myth, dark humour, working-class grit and radioactivity in Brazil’s Northeast.

title: Ali G: Who Iz I?
overview: Plot details TBA.

title: INHUMATION
overview: After being pronounced dead prematurely, a man afflicted with a rare condition is determined to put his fears to rest - no matter the cost.

title: Flamin­go Flamenco
overview: The Fuente de Piedra lagoon in Spain is home to one of the largest flocks of flamingos in Europe. Once a year, the adolescent birds perform a dance that looks like... flamenco! But when the flock is attacked by hateful podencos (wild dogs) our heroine Rosie, a fun, dance crazy flamingo, loses her beloved sister and the flamenco is cancelled henceforth. She grows up a shadow of her former self, robbed of her sisters love and the joy of dance. One day she meets Carlos, an exuberant lizard, who encourages her to dance once more - rekindling her inner flame. Over time, she transforms back into her old confident self, before leading her flock to face down the podencos and dance once more.

title: Die andere Seite
overview: Since losing her family, a woman is living alone in the wilderness — far away from society, which is dominated by mistrust and fear after the outbreak of a fatal disease. When she is forced to leave this life behind, she not only experiences a boundless freedom, but also remembers the importance of human closeness and the feeling of belonging.

title: A Dog's Show
overview: A disillusioned sheep dog triallist must come out of retirement and team up with his granddaughter to confront and defeat his nemesis - a mischievous sheep called Dolores - and overcome his neighbour, in order to save his family farm.

title: Wonder Beast
overview: With fairy-tale inhabitants, everything is the same as with people - when a marriage breaks up, Resentment remains... That is the name of the daughter of the powerful magicians Bolotnitsa and Chernogor, who divorced but continue to share power over the child. On the day of Resentment's coming of age, it turns out that she is deprived of the magical power that was supposed to be inherited from her parents. To fix the situation, Resentment urgently needs to find a groom in the human world, have a wedding and sacrifice the person - turn him into a tree... Together with Resentment, her mysterious friend, Chudo Yudo, goes to the human world. He can transform into anyone: a bird, an animal, and even a handsome prince.

title: Materia Prima
overview: The Bolivian Andes are rich in both lithium and drama in a film about a new gold rush, where global interests collide and 500 years of colonial history continue to haunt the present.

title: SYNTHETICA
overview: Ada, a retired hacker living quietly as an art curator, discovers an illegal neural implant in their head after experiencing dangerous memory glitches. When an underground surgeon can't safely remove it, Ada is forced to accept one last job: infiltrate the corporation that created the device. As the mission unfolds, Ada must confront the truth about their forgotten past and the real purpose of the technology buried in their mind.

title: Little Hearts: Madness of Love
overview: A broke, desperate filmmaker fakes a public proposal to chase online fame. It goes viral, turning into real love, real fallout, and a harsh choice feed the algorithm or protect his heart in a world where emotions are content, at any cost

title: Caught Between Lands
overview: An experimental documentary featuring international college students commenting on their experiences of cultural isolation in America.

title: EESHAN - THE PROTECTOR
overview: An upcoming Indian feature film currently in development.  The project approaches myth and futurism with restraint, exploring responsibility, balance, and human choice without spectacle or exposition.

title: Other Mommy
overview: A young girl, Bela, forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home who looks uncannily like her own mother.

title: Faust
overview: After making a deal with the devil, an isolated and unsatisfied professor uses supernatural means to achieve success and happiness at the cost of his soul.

title: The Diary of a Chambermaid
overview: Gianina, a young Romanian, works as a housekeeper for a bourgeois family in Bordeaux. In the evenings, she rehearses the role of a maid with an amateur theater troupe in an adaptation of The Diary of a Chambermaid by Octave Mirbeau. She takes care of Louen, her employers’ son, while her own daughter is growing up far from her, in Romania. The maternal absence deepens into a wound but, as Christmas approaches, the promise of a reunion begins to take shape.

title: Lapland War
overview: Young soldier Heikki fights on the Karelian Isthmus alongside his friend Pauli. Arvo, recently released from prison, joins the company, challenging the others' views on war and duty with his worldview. The ceasefire raises hopes of returning home, but it soon becomes clear that Finland must turn against its former German allies in Lapland. At the same time, Saara, who works as a German interpreter in Rovaniemi, must choose her future: stay in Finland or flee to Germany with her beloved, Major Duisberg.

title: A Talent for a Murder
overview: A young man travels from New York to Switzerland to try to persuade acclaimed thriller writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final installment of her Tom Ripley series, with his efforts gradually turning more sinister.

title: Animol
overview: Behind the walls of a young offender institution, Troy is thrust into a brutal world of gangs, loyalty and violence from the moment he arrives. When an unspoken bond develops with a fellow inmate, it becomes a dangerous vulnerability for them.

title: Paul and Greg and Amelia
overview: A novelist struggling with writer's block interviews his wealthy estranged college roommate and his wife, where an old secret threatens all of their safety.

title: In the Clear Moonlit Dusk
overview: The school’s cool, prince-like heroine has never questioned her role—until a fellow “Prince” enters her life and sees her as more than a hero, awakening feelings she’s never faced before.

title: Ghosts: The Possession of Button House
overview: It's a matter of life and death for Alison, Mike, Mia and the Ghosts.

title: La Venganza del Charro Negro
overview: The return of Leo San Juan and all the legends.

title: The Bog
overview: A boy's body is discovered in a peat field, and a local drunk confesses to a decades-old murder. Policeman Broze reopens the case and is forced to confront his own role in the tragic game played by boys 30 years ago—a day he can't remember or forget.

title: The Bad Son
overview: Rubén, an eleven-year-old boy, lives in a rural area with his father until he suddenly disappears. In the aftermath, Rubén moves in with his grandmother, a woman he barely knows and with whom he must learn to coexist. In a setting where time seems to have stood still, their relationship gradually reveals a family history shaped by wounds passed down from one generation to the next. As Rubén grows older, he tries to understand this emotional legacy and find a way to break the cycle, confronting his past in an attempt to heal what he has inherited.

title: Musical Hetalia ~World⭐︎Starts~
overview: Tenth musical adaptation for Hetalia

title: Picasso's Mermaid
overview: Mary accidentally discovers a mermaid drawn on the wall of her small apartment in Warsaw. It turns out it was drawn by Pablo Picasso during his visit in 1948! She's thrilled, but she doesn't realize the mermaid will turn her life upside down.

title: Lions in Winter
overview: Opening with a tragic crime, whose perpetrator attempts to hide his tracks, including his relationship to people in power and organized crime. The father of the victim – his daughter – who thought he had left behind a life marked by violence, decides to seek justice on his own, crossing red lines from which there is no return. If there is anything more dangerous than a father defending his children, is a father who no longer has any children to defend.

title: Made in Abyss: Mezameru Shinpi
overview: Sequel to Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun.

title: Swamp
overview: Years after her mother's disappearance, Jamie and her friends return to the lake where the woman claimed to see a terrifying creature. Soon after arriving, the keys to their car go missing, leaving the group trapped.

title: The Elephant Odyssey
overview: The highly unusual trek by a herd of elephants as they diverted from their usual habitat and marched over 1,000 km in China across remote Yunnan Province. They attracted global attention, including live-streamed drone footage.

title: Neural Command
overview: In a cold future, where society is controlled by technology. Ethan, has a flash of his life before and starts to question what it means to truly live.

title: Convince Me
overview: When a heartbroken man is forced to convince the Devil to grant his wish, he must face the truth about himself or risk paying an eternal price.

title: Carrerilla
overview: A young waiter goes through his daily routine, shaped by haste, indifference, and a sense of disconnection from the world around him. Throughout the day, a series of small encounters: at work, on the street, and within his own community; reveal his inability to truly engage with the people around him.

title: Wired Together
overview: Told through the memories of a young writer, Wired Together follows a relationship that unfolds chapter by chapter as Ivy transforms moments of first meetings, shared adventures, and growing distance into the pages of her novel. As past and present intertwine, she discovers that some stories continue to shape us long after they are written.

title: Nicolás de Jesús' Now You See Me...
overview: Struggling fair owner Kesselring (Nicolás de Jesús) is given a unique opportunity to restore the fair to its former glory when his friend Dr. Goodkat (Fredy Roque) introduces him to Marcus Kelevra (Alexis Adrián), a man whose mysterious act will draw people back to the fair, at a deadly cost, and even sparking interest among his fellow fairgoers.

title: Growth of the Soil
overview: It is late autumn. Isak fights to survive in the wilderness. One day, Inger appears over the mountain. Out of a meeting in need, love grows. In merciless nature, Isak and Inger fight to create a life together. With love as their driving force, they build the farm Sellanraa from nothing. When a dark secret comes to the surface, love is put to the test.

title: Moulin
overview: In June 1943, Jean Moulin, leader of the French Resistance, is arrested while attempting to reunite the forces of the "Armée Secrète." Interrogated by Klaus Barbie, the head of the Gestapo in Lyon, Moulin is drawn into a relentless confrontation.

title: Species
overview: Margot, a young intern at the country's most competitive ER, struggles in the high-pressure environment. When multiple patients her age arrive with strange symptoms, her own body begins experiencing alarming transformations.

title: Words of Love
overview: For 14 years, Erika has been the anchor of a household that rarely stands still, doing her best to raise teenage Abigail, her whirlwind little brother, Yoni, and a dog with an extreme devotion to cheese. When Abi’s desire to meet her absent father grows into a full-blown obsession and word spreads he’s been seen nearby, Erika fears the fragile balance will collapse for good. Instead, the unpredictable journey that follows brings mother and daughter to see each other anew, steering their lively, lovable family toward a happy new chapter.

title: Lucy Lost
overview: Set in 1915 in the Isles of Scilly just off the Cornish coast, a young girl named Lucy is raised by a clan of fishermen she knows not to be hers. However, she remembers little else about her past, and as the Great War rages down on the continent, a chance encounter with the mysterious girl her own age soon helps Lucy put back the pieces of her own life’s story and come to better understand her place in the world.

title: Le Fantôme de l'Opéra
overview: Anastasia, an 18-year-old ballet dancer at the Opéra Garnier, becomes the obsession of a disfigured man living in the opera's underground labyrinth.

title: Paper Cuts
overview: A deeper look into Switzerland's counterfeits during WWII.

title: Free at Heart
overview: Sebastian's (16) sheltered small-town life changes suddenly when his family takes in 15-year-old Kolja, supposedly the son of his father's recently deceased girlfriend. In addition to his little sister, another teenager now lives with them.  Although the two boys are strangers to each other at first, they begin to open up to each other more and more and discover that they are biological brothers. The relationship of trust with his parents breaks down and when Sebastian and Kolja become closer than they expected, Sebastian's life is suddenly turned upside down, as he has found not only a soul mate in his new brother, but also a real, first love. Overwhelmed by their feelings, the two hide their relationship, but when the secret, incestuous relationship is discovered, the family breaks out of the social structure of the small town and comes into conflict with societal norms. Everything that follows is a rollercoaster of emotions.

title: The Last Roman God
overview: Through both personal and political conflicts, the film tells the story of emperor Diocletian's rise to power and his complicated place in ancient Rome's court politics.

title: MEAT
overview: A homeless family accepts shelter in a luxurious, remote ranch. What they don’t know is that their arrival was anticipated, and the baby they’re expecting is the main course of a hungry system.

title: 100 Days
overview: "100 Days" is a feature film about Brazilian explorer Amyr Klink, who crossed the South Atlantic Ocean in 1984. It blends adventure, family drama, and emotional flashbacks from his childhood and teen years.

title: The Fox
overview: An affable hunter encounters a shape-shifting fox who offers him an opportunity to transform his partner into the perfect woman and in doing so take control of the natural world.

title: Das Geheimnis der gestohlenen Maske
overview: Does the mask of the Makonde really have magic powers and can it settle the terrible quarrel between Johanna and her best friend? Johanna desperately needs the mask, but before her eyes it is stolen from Leipzig's Grassi Museum and Grandpa Kito is considered the prime suspect! Kito has just appeared from Tanzania and wants the mask, brutally stolen in colonial times, to return to his village. For Johanna, there is more at stake than unmasking the real thief - she must find her own identity.

title: Biermann
overview: Portrait of the German-German singer-songwriter and intellectual Wolf Biermann, whose famous Cologne concert in 1976 made German history.

title: Rise of the Empire
overview: Upon returning home from his Grand Embassy, Peter the Great enters into a prolonged war with Sweden to secure access to the Baltic Sea. His path to victory is paved with setbacks, treachery, and deceit. Only by overcoming these challenges will he become Emperor, find true love, and establish Russia as a great empire.

title: City of Fathers
overview: A father and son have nothing in common except a first name, Richard, and an apartment on a housing estate. The burly, good-natured, 30-something factory worker listens to heavy metal and occasionally lets his girlfriend into his life. The frail, retired teacher, who raised the boy after his mother’s departure, is the embodiment of care and understanding. However, their tranquil, shared reality, which embraces both the hardcore band Našrot and Bergman’s “Cries and Whispers,” is disrupted by the sudden death of the mother. Young Richard sets out on a peculiar initiation journey with bizarre encounters and moments of unexpected enlightenment.

title: We Are Born Good
overview: A dining mishap caused a rift between Ji and Rui, leading to a cycle of revenge. Their already troubled lives only came together to fall apart.

title: Bloody Tennis
overview: Sophie joins a prestigious tennis academy, where the brutality of competitive sports is taken to its extreme and only the hungriest survive.

title: God Laughs
overview: In the heart of the 17th century, Friar Leopoldo da Casamacchia recounts the Gospel with a joy and freedom never seen before. While the Church speaks in Latin, he speaks to the people of a God who is close to them, capable of bringing comfort, hope, and even of laughing alongside them. His voice spreads from village to village, winning over thousands of people and emptying the churches. The echo of his message reaches as far as Rome, where the Pope entrusts the case to Cardinal Maculani, the most influential inquisitor of the time. What begins as a trial turns into an unexpected confrontation, capable of shaking seemingly unshakable convictions. While Leopoldo’s fate seems sealed, doubt begins to change even those who judge him. Because you can silence a voice, but not what that voice has left behind in others.

title: As Dez Vantagens de Morrer Depois de Você

Sense and Sensibility
overview: A charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood.

title: The Mongoose
overview: A falsely accused war hero with nothing to lose leads police on an epic televised cross-country car chase, helped by members of his former Special Forces Army battalion and closely monitored by a fascinated public rooting for his safe getaway.

title: Every Breath We Take
overview: A murder investigation in a small rural town, marked by silences and loyalties, uncovers old secrets. Adoniran, a respected investigator, sees his life collapse when he goes from agent to prime suspect. While trying to prove his innocence, Saulo, Special Agent of Internal Affairs, returns to his hometown and must confront memories he would rather forget. Inner conflicts, fragile alliances, and unresolved recollections make the search for truth increasingly dangerous.

title: Proposal
overview: When a brother tries to stop his sister from proposing to her girlfriend, the siblings peel back the layers of their relationship in real time.

title: Everest: The Other Side
overview: Documentary by Jimmy Chin and Elizabeth Chai Vasarhelyi

title: RYUJI ⻯⼆
overview: The eternal legend etched into Japanese film history, rises again. (remake of the 1983 eponymous film).

title: Dead Howling
overview: A werewolf hunts zombies after losing his family. He meets two humans seeking sanctuary and joins their quest, protecting them with his powers. Their journey grows perilous as zombies start evolving.

title: Bad Day at the Office
overview: A man with amnesia wakes up in a wrecked hotel room next to a corpse, triggering a dangerous conspiracy. He and a maid try to recover his memories and evade the police to uncover the mystery and survive those pursuing them.

title: No More Punk Time
overview: A documentary chronicling the history and final days of the Crayola House, a legendary DIY punk venue in Harrisonburg, Virginia. Through archival footage, live performances, and interviews with musicians, artists, and former residents, the film captures the spirit of a community built on music, creativity, and collective resistance as it faces displacement and the end of an era.

title: Stiletto
overview: A year after the grisly murder of a local exotic dancer, the victim’s sister, Lyric, searches for the serial killer responsible as he stalks and kills his favorite dancers on the night of the anniversary.

title: Christmas at the Kringles
overview: The Seversons, a family of three living in smalltown suburbia, whose next-door neighbors, the Kringles, have one minor quirk: They celebrate Christmas all year round. Mark and Julie Severson have mixed feelings about how much time their son, Bobby, spends at the Kringles’. But it’s not until he goes missing within the confines of the Kringles’ home that they realize their neighbors—and their religion—aren’t what they seemed. The couple will embark on a life-and-death journey to find their son that not only tests who they are, but who they want to become.

title: In the Shadows
overview: Tells the true story of Ramla Ali, who fled Somalia with her family as a young girl, seeking asylum in London from the civil war. As a teenager, she pursued her love of boxing, but did so secretly as she knew her family would disapprove. Ali became the first boxer, male or female, to represent Somalia at the 2020 Olympic Games and made history after winning the first ever professional female boxing match in Saudi Arabia.

title: Sleepwalker
overview: After isolating himself from the outside world, a troubled sleepwalker discovers the pathway to an alternate reality, where he is guided by a mysterious entity. As he ventures further, he descends into the darkest corners of his subconscious.

title: Better Than A Shovel
overview: Carolyn and Howard are loving parents to their son Benny, but when they discover Benny may be developing unusual and dangerous behaviors, they devise a high risk mission in hopes of finding him a cure.

title: The Anta Claus of the South Pole
overview: Envious of his northern counterpart, the Anta Claus of the South Pole embarks on a penguin-powered journey to uncover the secret of a flawless Christmas. Along the way, he learns that the true spirit of the holiday lies not in perfection but in the lovable community of oddballs he left behind.

title: Sweet New Suit
overview: This film takes place within the lives of two friends that conflict with one another, as "Q" can't take responsibility for his actions and loosely getting "Jazz" involved.

title: Sight & Sound Presents: JOSHUA Live!
overview: Journey alongside the people of Israel as they navigate their newfound freedom in an unforgiving wilderness and under a new leader, Joshua. Captured in front of a live audience, JOSHUA LIVE! combines the energy of stage performance with the immersive experience of the cinema, bringing this unforgettable story of faith, courage and redemption to movie theaters.

title: Absolution
overview: A character driven short drama about grief and survivors guilt set in Las Vegas.

title: Gods Don't Give Gifts
overview: "Gods Don't Give Gifts" traces the fallout of humanity besting earthly limitations like death and memory through technology and how it grapples with humanity as a result.

title: The Pinecrest Lost Tapes: Chaos! Blood! & Violence
overview: Since the early 90s, Pinecrest, Massachusetts has suffered unexplained horrors. Nolan vanished without a trace in a winter storm. 23 years later, seven friends in a park discover the Rabbit has returned to Pinecrest.

title: KUMLAN
overview: This is footage recorded in 2005 and released years later. It concerns a low-budget paranormal show that was investigating the possible existence of a mysterious creature from local folklore in the forests of Thailand.

title: REEL
overview: After a late-night slasher screening, a group of horror-loving friends find themselves trapped in a terrifying game where slasher movie rules become reality. As eerie events unfold, they realize someone is rewriting the genre—forcing them to fight for survival in a film that’s still being written. The only way out? Break the rules before it’s too late.

title: Forget-me-not
overview: Dean Carter's mind unravels while deciphering the mystery behind the disappearance of his fiancé.

title: A Corpse in Kensington
overview: A mysterious killing spree ignites suspicion among three former classmates who have rekindled a love triangle in their hometown on Halloween night.

title: Carnal
overview: A lonely misogynist experiences strange occurrences after purchasing a peculiar product online.

title: + Add Friend
overview: A working man must confront his secret shame as his online activity unravels into his personal life- following an intimate encounter with an anonymous internet user.

title: Scream: Short Film
overview: After a brutal murder reawakens Woodsboro's dark past, Cora Clemenzo is pulled into a new Ghostface killing spree as her friends in the Woodsboro High Cinema Club become suspects and survival means uncovering the truth before history repeats itself...

title: Nightblade
overview: The Nightblade Killer is on the loose during the night of a full moon.

title: Wolfmask 2: The return of Dario Durant
overview: As the survivors try to rebuild their lives, Víctor, the brother of one of the victims, forms a group to stop what many believe is just a legend. But revenge never rests, and the past always finds a way to return.

title: Slash
overview: A group of friends are terrorized by a masked killer on Halloween.

title: Watergate
overview: A sequel to Rupert v Nixon and the end for the RNCU

title: Black Hollow
overview: Set in the rural Midwest during the 1970s, Black Hollow follows Jessica, an innocent young girl sheltered by small-town faith and her worldly friend Helen, whose rebellious streak leads them both into danger. When the two sneak out one foggy night, they wander to a forgotten churchyard, an isolated place where sacred ground conceals something unholy. As darkness descends, Jessica's search for belonging turns to horror, forcing her to confront the evil that thrives beneath the surface of the American heartland.

title: Therapy with a Zombie
overview: A zombie seeks therapy after realising he's addicted to eating brains.

title: Lights! Camera!! Scream!!!
overview: A group of friends travel to Maine to make a low-budget horror film, only to discover the behind-the-scenes chaos is far more terrifying.

title: Demonology
overview: A small team of paranormal investigators are hired to investigate a remote property where a grieving couple claims to have encountered a demonic force. As they unravel the mystery, they begin to realize they are not welcome.

title: Bullet and Lace
overview: Bullet and Lace, a neon-soaked, Giallo-inspired nightmare, follows a young woman whose favorite true crime podcast becomes the voice of the masked intruder stalking her through the night.

title: Hellbox IV - The Key Of Evil
overview: The key of evil is forged in hell, and a demon escapes with it, asking for help from the former priest Rodrigo, what he doesn't know is that the devil's bounty hunter is coming for the search, with all the forces of darkness with him.

title: Beyond The Threshold
overview: A novice filmmaker delves into an unresolved case from the past, unwittingly awakening ancestral forces that begin to transform her and those around her in dark ways

title: Knock, Knock, Knock
overview: Three years after the Jamestown NightStalker murders in 2024 that killed both his brothers, Collin Woods lives in a state of confusion and paranoia. Seeing a psychiatrist and living with his best friend, his symptoms worsen when a reoccurring dream predicts the return of The NightStalker. As people around Collin begin to be killed, he is forced to confront his fate, or watch as The NightStalker takes the couple things he still has left.

title: Girl Hell
overview: Upcoming Found Footage Short Film from Lucille Hanson. Plot TBA

title: Nowhere to Run
overview: A young woman’s pursuit of online stardom during a period of isolation after running away from home gradually becomes a living nightmare at the hands of a stalker who has convinced himself that he holds the key to unlocking her criminal past.

title: Power-Man
overview: Power-Man, the masked vigilante of Vancouver, meets a new enemy when he seizes control of television and uses it to brainwash the people of the city to become his minions.
